user.title: Hattrick
user.description: Choose how to connect your Hattrick account.

manual.title: CHPP credentials
manual.description: Enter the credentials obtained by registering an app on chpp.hattrick.org and authorizing it on your account.

auth.title: Authorize on Hattrick
auth.description:
1. Open {authorize_url} in your browser and log in to Hattrick.
2. Click "Allow".
3. Copy the verifier code shown and paste it below.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authorize Hattrick
reauth_confirm.description: The access token has been revoked. Open {authorize_url} in your browser, click "Allow" and paste the new verifier.

error.cannot_connect: Unable to connect to CHPP. Please try again later.

abort.already_configured: This Hattrick account is already configured.
